devops.name: NPM Package Publishing
devops.code:
# .github/workflows/publish.yml
name: Publish to NPM

on:
  release:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
      
      - name: Publish to NPM
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

# package.json publish config
{
  "name": "@octo/core",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Language-agnostic micro-frontend framework",
  "main": "dist/index.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "README.md"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public"
  }
}

businessRequirements.businessContext: Create a state-of-the-art, language-agnostic micro-frontend framework featuring server-side rendering and an intuitive CLI for streamlined project generation and management
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Existing micro-frontend solutions force framework lock-in, lack server-side rendering capabilities, and require complex manual setup, slowing down development and limiting architectural flexibility
businessValue: Framework independence allows teams to choose the best tool for each component
Built-in SSR improves SEO and initial page load performance
CLI automation reduces project setup from hours to minutes
Component isolation prevents style and JavaScript conflicts
Unified developer experience across multiple frameworks
acceptanceCriteria: ✓ Support for React, Vue, Svelte, and Preact components
✓ CLI generates projects with single command

risks.mitigation: Peer dependency management and adapter versioning
